diagnosis: The handler dynamically initializes TenantOAuthSettings and calls get_secret_value() on client_secret, returning it in the HTTP response. It does not verify that current_user belongs to tenant_slug or has admin privileges, allowing any logged-in user to leak OAuth client secrets of any tenant.
exploit_request:
GET /api/v1/settings/oauth/enterprise-corp HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
